# Area: visualqa

Started by the build lead from this brief (2026-11-13). It is the definition of done.

LEAD ORDER (URGENT, Josh's screen 15:50, Director's Cut gameplay looks broken; you are on Opus). Lane visualqa owns: stand-in draw rules (tools/build/art_slots.py, pipeline/art/standins.json, the generated art slot catalog, ArtSlot/UiArt/SceneArt/Vfx presenter code that draws stand-ins), route/wind stand-in cube visibility, scene panels/bars, and a new visual-QA tool. Fix: (1) Wind gusts draw as big framed boxes: the gust stand-in draft has frame and border lines baked in, is not keyed, and is stretched per wind field and sometimes rotated. Rule for every stand-in: if it is not keyed on transparency (opaque corners/edges) or has frame borders, it falls back to the plain placeholder or is not drawn. Enforce it in art_slots.py (a check that flags opaque-corner or bordered stand-ins, with a test) and apply it to the gusts first. (2) A large lilac square still shows on the route (not the Keeper arena): a route or wind stand-in cube. Hide stand-in cubes where art exists, or tint them to fit the palette. (3) Cream bars: a cream strip across the bottom and one on the right, panels with no art. Do not draw a panel with no art (or draw it in the scene palette). (4) Ella missing on the route is B6, levelchunks is fixing it; do not touch the route start. (5) Add a visual-QA step: tools/build/visual_qa.py captures each screen in a real windowed game (title, Start Game play, Director's Cut route, Keeper fight, Defeated, credits; use the smoke/journey hooks) and has an Opus judge (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5, image input, no tools) list anything a player would call broken (boxes, borders, flat squares, bars, missing hero, unreadable text) with a PASS/FAIL per screen; tests for its parsing; write results to pipeline/qa/visual/. Run it before and after your fixes and commit both reports. Pixel counts and not-black checks missed all of this; the judge's words are the bar. Each code fix gets a break-checked automation test. Merge origin/main first and often; ue_slot for every Unreal run; commit only with a clean tree; pre-check PASS for the exact tip. The lead needs a Director's Cut route capture after the fix (pipeline/qa/visual/after/dc-route.png).
